title: P2 smoke: candidate mechanism/ranking audit
kind: P2 single-variable candidate replacement audit; discovery only
hypothesis: The P1 trace analysis found 1 promotion gap and 3 precision gaps: the reference concept was already in the reasoning/findings, but the model selected a weaker or adjacent mechanism. A second audit that maps each finding to a hypothesis and replaces it with a more specific mechanism should improve candidate precision without adding tools or reference labels.
selection_reason: youtube-dl-2 is the clearest promotion gap (duplicate representation_id overwrites fragments was already hypothesized but not emitted); tornado-3 is a precision gap (cache/close present, but the candidate chose __new__). Both sides, one r0 window per side.
metrics: reference candidate hit on the two cases
adoption: At least one reference candidate hit in mechanism_audit on youtube-dl-2 or tornado-3, with no fixed-side alarm; a four-window smoke only, not a general improvement claim.
scope: Discovery only; no evidence engine, official tests/labels/opposite version in the Agent input. One repetition; all requests, failures, replacements and fallbacks retained. The audit prompt contains no reference labels.
